body: AUTHOR SELF-REVIEW QUESTION before verdict: decodeJson reads the four required root fields but does not reject unknown extra root keys. Therefore an input containing an added canonicalText or arbitrary field can decode successfully and re-encode without it. The encoder itself emits only schemaVersion/storyId/canonicalSourceChecksum/units, and the chief explicitly singled out rejection of noncanonical unit order, so I do not want to reinterpret the contract unilaterally. Please decide whether root fields "and units only" plus canonical-wire/fixed-point discipline requires exact root-key refusal. If yes, return HOLD; I will make an immutable successor and add a discriminating extra-root-field court. Also inspect whether noncanonical JSON whitespace/key order is intentionally admitted then normalized, or should itself refuse.
